quaveringly.definition: in an unsteady quavering manner; "the man began quaveringly to question the soldier"

queasily.definition: in a queasy manner; "`Do I have to remove the liver,' the medical student asked queasily"

queerly.definition: in a strange manner; "a queerly inscribed sheet of paper"

questionably.definition: in a questionable and dubious manner; "these were estates his father questionably acquired"

questioningly.definition: in a curious and questioning manner; "they turned their heads questioningly, as if awaiting further instructions"

quickly.definition: with speed; "he works quickly"; "John got ready in short order"

quietly.definition: with low volume; "speak softly but carry a big stick"; "she spoke quietly to the child"; "the radio was playing softly"

quite.definition: to a degree (not used with a negative); "quite tasty"; "quite soon"; "quite ill"; "quite rich"

quixotically.definition: in a quixotic manner; "sent to jail for two years, he has quixotically refused to clear himself by betraying his colleagues"

quizzically.definition: in a quizzical and questioning manner; "they looked quizzically at the doctor"
